title: Pup in the Mud
summary: A puppy gets muddy and needs a bath, discovering all five short vowels.

pages.scene: A golden retriever puppy running playfully
The puppy digging enthusiastically in muddy ground
The mud-covered puppy shaking, mud flying everywhere

pages.text: A hen sat on a log.
pages.scene: A brown hen perched on wood, watching the puppy
The hen clucking and bobbing its head disapprovingly
A child and adult preparing a bathtub outside
The muddy puppy sitting in a tub of soapy water

pages.text: The pup got wet and clean.
pages.scene: A clean, fluffy puppy being dried with a towel
Happy child hugging clean puppy, both smiling
